title: Smp resources
description: The Perfekt modpack for SMP Servers
body:
its a performance-optimized SMP modpack for Minecraft Java Edition, designed for competitive survival servers inspired by high-intensity SMP gameplay.

🔥 Built for Performance

Carefully selected optimization mods ensure smooth FPS, reduced lag spikes, and stable multiplayer performance — even on mid-range systems.

⚔ PvP-Focused Gameplay

Clear visuals, reduced visual clutter, and combat-friendly tweaks give you maximum awareness during fights. Perfect for duels, raids, and clan wars.

🌍 Balanced SMP Core

No unnecessary tech overload. This pack keeps the survival experience competitive, fair, and community-driven.

🎨 Clean & Modern Design

Minimal UI improvements, subtle visual upgrades, and a polished overall feel — without drifting too far from vanilla.

🛠 Quality of Life Enhancements

Smart improvements that streamline gameplay while preserving the core Minecraft experience.

Whether you're building a powerful base, running an economy, raiding enemies, or dominating PvP events — this modpack delivers a smooth and competitive SMP foundation.
